title: 2024年6月四级真题 第3套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 The art of persuasion means convincing others to agree with your point of view or to follow your course of action. For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally. For the rest of us, persuasion skills can be learned and developed over time.

P2 Employers place a great value on employees with persuasion skills because they can impact several aspects of job performance. Besides, teamwork and leadership rely heavily on the power of persuasion to get things done. Without persuasion skills, employees may not be as committed to or convinced of the importance of an organization's vision and long-term mission. Effective use of persuasion skills will not only help get your coworkers excited about your ideas, it'll also help you motivate them to achieve a common goal.

P3 In order to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace, you need to understand how to handle conflicts and reach agreements. Good communication is the first step in effective persuasion, but logic and reasoning are just as important. Before you can get somebody on-board with your goal, you should help them understand why they should pursue it. Using visual aids to back up your ideas can help communicate your ideas better and make compelling arguments so your listeners will come to a logical choice and become fully committed to your ideas and plans.

P4 Successful persuasion skills are based on your ability to have positive interactions and maintain meaningful relationships with people. In order to sustain those relationships, you must be able to work in their best interests as well. Your coworkers are more likely to agree with you when they succeed alongside you. The more they achieve and the greater progress they make, the more they trust your judgement and strength.

P5 We persuade and get persuaded every day—we're either convincing or being convinced. A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures; no one likes to be told what to do or to be pushed around. Therefore, organizations and leaders should adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes.

questions.q: What does the author say about the ability to be persuasive in the first paragraph?
options: People may either be born with it or be able to cultivate it.
It proves crucial in making others follow one's course of action.
It refers to the natural and instinctive power of influencing one's coworkers.
People may view it as both a means to convince others and an art of communication.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about the ability to be persuasive in the first paragraph? 是典型的 What does the author say + 段落限定，问的是作者在指定段落对某事的具体说 法，无 infer/imply 字样。 51. What does the author say about the ability to be persuasive in the first paragraph? A) People may either be born with it or be able to cultivate it. B) It proves crucial in making others follow one's course of action. C) It refers to the natural and instinctive power of influencing one's coworkers. D) People may view it as both a means to convince others and an art of communication.

【拆句】题干 What does the author say about the ability to be persuasive in the first paragraph? 主干为 What does the author say about X，X 是 the ability to be persuasive；in the first paragraph 是地点状语修饰 say。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally. For the rest of us, persuasion skills can be learned and developed over time. 对我们中的一些人来说，说服是与生俱来的天赋，影响他人的能力是天生的；对我们其余的 人来说，说服技巧是可以随时间学习并培养的。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality ↔born with it persuasion skills can be learned and developed over time ↔be able to cultivate it 预判要求“天生或后天习得”两端都覆盖，仅 People may either be born with it or be able to cultivate it 用 either...or 句式完整对应两端。 B) 答非所问 It proves crucial in making others follow one's course of action 把首段对“能力来 源”的说明换成了“能力的重要性”，回答的不是 What does the author say 这个角度的 问题。 C) 以偏概全 It refers to the natural and instinctive power of influencing one's coworkers 只截 取了“天生本能”那一半（some of us），漏掉了“后天习得”那一半（the rest of us）， 且把场景窄化到 coworkers。 D) 无中生有 People may view it as both a means to convince others and an art of communication 中的 art of communication 在首段并未提及，原文只说 the art of persuasion，把 persuasion 偷换成 communication。 为什么说服技巧在职场中备受重视? A) 它们使员工能够相信自己的长期收益。 B) 它们使员工能够无条件地信任他们的领导者。 C) 它们有助于激励同事为共同目标而奋斗。 D) 它们有助于组织有效地拓宽其愿景。

questions.q: Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace?
options: They enable employees to be convinced of their long-term gains.
They enable employees to trust their leaders unconditionally.
They help motivate coworkers to strive for a common goal.
They help an organization to broaden its vision effectively.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace? 问的是被广泛重视的具体原 因，是文中可直接读出的事实，不要求跨段综合推断。 52. Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace? A) They enable employees to be convinced of their long-term gains. B) They enable employees to trust their leaders unconditionally. C) They help motivate coworkers to strive for a common goal. D) They help an organization to broaden its vision effectively.

【拆句】题干 Why are persuasion skills greatly valued in the workplace? 是 Why + be + 过去 分词 valued 构成的被动疑问句，主语是 persuasion skills；in the workplace 是地点状 语。被动语态把动作发出方（雇主）省略了，考生需要意识到“被谁所重视”的隐含主语在原 文是 employers。

【定位】Effective use of persuasion skills will not only help get your coworkers excited about your ideas, it'll also help you motivate them to achieve a common goal. 有效运用说服技巧不仅有助于让你的同事对你的想法感到兴奋，也有助于你激励他们为实现 共同目标而努力。

【选项】A) 无中生有 They enable employees to be convinced of their long-term gains 中的 long-term gains 在原文找不到对应，原文 long-term mission 谈的是组织的长期使命，并非员工 的长远收益。 B) 过度推断 They enable employees to trust their leaders unconditionally 中 unconditionally 是绝对化表述，原文只谈“激励”，从未要求“无条件信任”，属于过度推断。 C) ✓ 正确 help you motivate them to achieve a common goal ↔ help motivate coworkers to strive for a common goal 预判“激励同事为共同目标”两要素，They help motivate coworkers to strive for a common goal 在句法结构上几乎是原文的平移，是最贴近预判的选项。 D) 偷换概念 They help an organization to broaden its vision effectively 把原文的“让员工 committed to vision”（员工对愿景的认同）偷换成“拓展组织的愿景”（broaden its vision），动作和受体都被换掉。 人们应该做什么来学习职场中的说服艺术? A) 掌握有效的沟通技巧。 B) 避免卷入与他人的冲突。 C) 理解追求目标的原因。 D) 全身心地投入到自己的想法和计划中。

questions.q: What should people do to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace?
options: Acquire effective communication skills.
Avoid getting involved in conflicts with others.
Understand the reason for pursuing their goals.
Commit themselves fully to their ideas and plans.
questions.explain:
【判型】What should people do to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace? 提问“为达成 X 该做什么”，答案是原文中显性陈述的前置条件，无需推断。 53. What should people do to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace? A) Acquire effective communication skills. B) Avoid getting involved in conflicts with others. C) Understand the reason for pursuing their goals. D) Commit themselves fully to their ideas and plans.

【拆句】题干 What should people do to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace? 主干是 What should people do，to learn... at the workplace 是不定式做目的状语。考生易把 to learn 误读为定语修饰 do，正确理解应是“为了学会...，人们该做什么”。

【定位】Good communication is the first step in effective persuasion, but logic and reasoning are just as important. 良好的沟通是有效说服的第一步，但逻辑和推理同样重要。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 Good communication is the first step in effective persuasion ↔ Acquire effective communication skills 预判要求“先做好沟通”，Acquire effective communication skills 用 acquire 动作动词 直译 first step 隐含的“获取动作”，匹配度最高。 B) 偷换概念 Avoid getting involved in conflicts with others 把原文 how to handle conflicts（处 理冲突）偷换成 avoid... conflicts（回避冲突），原文从未让人避开冲突。 C) 张冠李戴 Understand the reason for pursuing their goals 把原文中的“帮别人理解为什么要追 求该目标”张冠到“自己理解”，主语错位。 D) 答非所问 Commit themselves fully to their ideas and plans 描述的是听众被说服后的状态 （fully committed），是“说服成功”的结果，而题干问的是说服者该做的前置条件。 什么时候你更有可能成功说服你的同事? A) 当他们确信你在为他们的利益工作而牺牲自己的利益时。 B) 当他们意识到你所做判断的潜在力量时。 C) 当他们意识到你与他们保持的有意义的关系时。 D) 当他们确信自己将与你一起取得成就时。

questions.q: When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers?
options: When they are convinced you work in their interests while sacrificing your own
When they become aware of the potential strength of the judgements you make
When they become aware of the meaningful relationships you keep with them.
When they are convinced they will make achievements together with you.
questions.explain:
【判型】When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers? 问的是某客观条 件下的可能性，文中第四段直陈条件句，可直接定位。

【拆句】题干 When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers? 主干是 When are you more likely to succeed，to succeed in doing 是固定搭配。考生易把 more likely 误读作纯感情色彩词，应理解为“在何种条件下，更可能”，相当于在问触发 条件。 54. When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers? A) When they are convinced you work in their interests while sacrificing your own B) When they become aware of the potential strength of the judgements you make C) When they become aware of the meaningful relationships you keep with them. D) When they are convinced they will make achievements together with you.

【定位】Your coworkers are more likely to agree with you when they succeed alongside you. 当你的同事与你一起取得成功时，他们更可能同意你的看法。

【选项】A) 过度推断 while sacrificing your own 是原文从未提及的“牺牲自我利益”，原文只说“为对方利益 着想”，未要求牺牲自己。 B) 偷换概念 the potential strength of the judgements you make 把原文 they trust your judgement and strength 中的并列两件事偷换成“判断的潜在力量”，concept 被悄悄 合并改写。 C) 答非所问 meaningful relationships you keep with them 是说服力的前提条件（说服者需要做 的事），不是同事被说服的触发条件——题干问的是后者。 D) ✓ 正确 when they succeed alongside you ↔ When they are convinced they will make achievements together with you 预判“双方共同成功才更易被说服”，they will make achievements together with you 是定位句 they succeed alongside you 的同义改写，方向一致。 为什么建议组织和领导者采用强有力的说服技巧来带来必要的变革? A) 为了让员工相信协作的价值。 B) 为了照顾到当今大多数人的偏好。 C) 为了改进传统的组织结构。 D) 为了适应员工不断变化的工作方式。

questions.q: Why are organizations and leaders advised to adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about
options: To convince employees of the value of collaboration
To allow for the preferences of most people of today
To improve on traditional organizational structures
To adapt to employees' ever-changing working styles
questions.explain:
【判型】Why are organizations and leaders advised to adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes? 问的是该建议的事实依据，文中末段直陈，无须推断。

【拆句】题干 Why are organizations and leaders advised to adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes? 是 Why + 被动 are advised to do 的疑问句，to bring about... 是不定式做目的状语。该结构隐含的动作发出方是“作者”，被建议方是 organizations and leaders；考生需识别这是在问作者给出此建议的依据。 55. Why are organizations and leaders advised to adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes? A) To convince employees of the value of collaboration B) To allow for the preferences of most people of today C) To improve on traditional organizational structures D) To adapt to employees' ever-changing working styles

【定位】A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures; no one likes to be told what to do or to be pushed around. Therefore, organizations and leaders should adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes. 绝大多数人更喜欢协作与团队合作，而非传统组织结构；没人喜欢被指使或被任意摆布。因 此，组织和领导者应当采用有力的说服技巧来带来必要的变革。

【选项】A) 答非所问 To convince employees of the value of collaboration 把“顺应大多数人偏好”换成了 “说服员工相信协作的价值”——原文是员工自己已经偏好协作，无需再被说服其价值。 B) ✓ 正确 A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures ↔To allow for the preferences of most people of today 题干问“为什么被建议这么做”，To allow for the preferences of most people of today 用 To do 不定式直接给出目的-原因，是最贴合预判的答案。 C) 无中生有 To improve on traditional organizational structures 把“改善传统组织结构”列为目 的，但原文 traditional organizational structures 出现的语境是“人们更偏好协作而非 传统组织结构”，并未把“改善”它作为说服技巧的目的。 D) 无中生有 To adapt to employees' ever-changing working styles 中的 ever-changing working styles（不断变化的工作方式）原文未提，原文谈的是“偏好”而非“工作方式的 变化”。
